text_en: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered:
text_cn: 纳阿玛人左法尔答复说：

text_en: “Pay attention! My thoughts urge me to answer, because of the agitation within me.
text_cn: 因我的思潮起伏，叫我答复，为此我内心十分急躁。

text_en: I hear censure that insults me, and a spirit beyond my understanding answers me.
text_cn: 斥责辱骂我的话，我已听到，我的理智催迫我答复。

text_en: Do you not know this from of old, ever since mortals were placed on earth,
text_cn: 你岂不知道，自古以来，自从世上有人以来，

text_en: that the exulting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless is but for a moment?
text_cn: 恶人的欢欣决不久长，无神者的喜乐瞬息即逝？

text_en: Even though they mount up high as the heavens, and their head reaches to the clouds,
text_cn: 他的骄傲虽高顶苍天，他的头虽插入青云，

text_en: they will perish forever like their own dung; those who have seen them will say, ‘Where are they? ’
text_cn: 但他必像幻像，永归无有； 见过他的人必说：“他那里去了？”

text_en: They will fly away like a dream, and not be found; they will be chased away like a vision of the night.
text_cn: 他又像梦境消散，无迹可寻；又像夜梦，消失无踪。

text_en: The eye that saw them will see them no more, nor will their place behold them any longer.
text_cn: 见过他的眼，再也见不到他；他的住所，再也不认识他。

text_en: Their children will seek the favor of the poor, and their hands will give back their wealth.
text_cn: 他的儿子要赔偿穷人的损害，他要亲手把财物交还。

text_en: Their bodies, once full of youth, will lie down in the dust with them.
text_cn: 他的骨骸虽富有魄力，但要同他一起埋于尘埃。

text_en: “Though wickedness is sweet in their mouth, though they hide it under their tongues,
text_cn: 邪恶在他口中虽觉甘甜，藏在他的舌下，

text_en: though they are loath to let it go, and hold it in their mouths,
text_cn: 他虽爱惜不舍，久久含在口中；

text_en: yet their food is turned in their stomachs; it is the venom of asps within them.
text_cn: 但那食物在他腹中要起变化，在他五内要变成蛇的毒汁。

text_en: They swallow down riches and vomit them up again; God casts them out of their bellies.
text_cn: 他并吞的财富，必要吐出，天主必使之由他腹中呕出。

text_en: They will suck the poison of asps; the tongue of a viper will kill them.
text_cn: 他原吸入了蛇的毒汁，毒蛇的舌头必将他杀死。

text_en: They will not look on the rivers, the streams flowing with honey and curds.
text_cn: 他不得观赏油流如溪，也看不到那流蜜流奶的小河。

text_en: They will give back the fruit of their toil, and will not swallow it down; from the profit of their trading they will get no enjoyment.
text_cn: 他劳力之所得，应该退还，不得吞下；赚来的财富，不得享用。

text_en: For they have crushed and abandoned the poor, they have seized a house that they did not build.
text_cn: 因为他压榨了穷人，使他们无依；强占了人家的房屋，不得再建。

text_en: “They knew no quiet in their bellies; in their greed they let nothing escape.
text_cn: 因为他口腹之欲总不知足，他所喜爱之物，也救不了他。

text_en: There was nothing left after they had eaten; therefore their prosperity will not endure.
text_cn: 没有什么能逃脱他的吞噬，他的幸福决不久长。

text_en: In full sufficiency they will be in distress; all the force of misery will come upon them.
text_cn: 他财产富足时，却不免拮据，各种的困苦齐集他身。

text_en: To fill their belly to the full God will send his fierce anger into them, and rain it upon them as their food.
text_cn: 当他肚腹饱满时，天主的怒火突然降到，箭如雨点射在他身上。

text_en: They will flee from an iron weapon; a bronze arrow will strike them through.
text_cn: 他逃避过铁器，铜矢必将他射穿。

text_en: It is drawn forth and comes out of their body, and the glittering point comes out of their gall; terrors come upon them.
text_cn: 一箭由他的脊背穿透，光亮的箭矢由他的胆囊穿出，死亡的恐怖已落在他身上。

text_en: Utter darkness is laid up for their treasures; a fire fanned by no one will devour them; what is left in their tent will be consumed.
text_cn: 层层黑暗留作他的宝藏，非人燃起的火要焚烧他，吞尽留在他帐幕的人。

text_en: The heavens will reveal their iniquity, and the earth will rise up against them.
text_cn: 天要彰显他的罪恶，地也起来攻击他。

text_en: The possessions of their house will be carried away, dragged off in the day of God’s wrath.
text_cn: 洪水冲走他的住宅，在天主义怒之日要全被冲去。

text_en: This is the portion of the wicked from God, the heritage decreed for them by God. ”
text_cn: 这是恶人由天主所应得的一份，是天主为他所注定的产业。
